item.title: Dal 0.1.11
item.description:
• Calmer colours: branch labels are neutral; only the branch you're on is a solid blue label, its line in the graph is blue and the other lanes step back
  • The current commit's row is tinted and the toolbar shows a branch icon, so you always see where you are
  • A checked-out branch inside a folder (feature/x) is pinned to the top of the sidebar

item.title: Dal 0.1.10
item.description: • Arrow keys move between files while a diff is open (↑/↓, Home/End), in the order the right panel shows them; the list scrolls along

item.title: Dal 0.1.9
item.description:
• Side panels have their own shade, so the graph, the branch list and the commit panel are easy to tell apart
  • Tab bar: larger names, the open project stands out as a raised tab, and a group's colour marks only the open tab

item.title: Dal 0.1.8
item.description:
• Merge tool: Current and Incoming side by side, pick single lines, see the base, live output you can edit, ⌘↑/⌘↓ between conflicts
  • Right-click menu in GitKraken's order: edit commit message, drop or move commits (with Undo), worktrees, patches, copy links, Solo, annotated tags, delete branch and remote together
  • Taller branch labels with clearer icons and ahead/behind counts
  • Faint lines between commit rows and between tabs

item.title: Dal 0.1.7
item.description:
• Security: repositories whose git settings would run programs open in Restricted mode (with Trust Repository); branch and tag names can't be mistaken for git options; the GitHub token is no longer visible to hooks; Open File won't launch apps or scripts; the update feed is signed and verified
  • Graph: a continuous line from each branch label to its commit; hovering a commit shows which branch it's on; hand cursor over rows
  • Faster and lighter: no GitHub CLI calls at launch, about 12% less memory with long histories
  • The main window always comes back, including from the Dock icon

item.title: Dal 0.1.6
item.description:
• "Discard All" moved into a ⋯ menu, away from "Stage All"
  • The commit button says what's missing; the summary counter appears as you type (amber past 50, red past 72)
  • Commit details show Checkout, Branch… and Cherry-pick, plus a ⋯ menu with every action
  • Branch names: spaces become dashes as you type
  • Clone fills in a git URL from the clipboard
  • Clearer pull request and quick switcher sheets

item.title: Dal 0.1.5
item.description:
• Hover a branch label to see every branch and tag on that commit, untruncated. Each label still checks out, opens its menu and drags.
  • Better contrast on both themes: meta text, status colours, graph lanes and avatars now meet WCAG contrast. Branch labels are larger.

item.title: Dal 0.1.4
item.description:
• Updates download in the background. When one is ready, the version badge at the top right becomes "Update ready · Restart Dal"; click it to install and relaunch, or it installs when you quit.
  • Settings → Updates: "Download updates in the background" toggle.

item.title: Dal 0.1.3
item.description: • The running version is always visible: a badge at the top right (build number, Check for Updates, release notes) and on the welcome screen

item.title: Dal 0.1.2
item.description:
• Quieter interface: one primary action per area, neutral toggles, file status as coloured glyphs
  • Sentence-case labels and one consistent type scale
  • Calmer conflict view and merge banner
  • Welcome screen with keycap shortcuts

item.title: Dal 0.1.1
item.description: • The sidebar, tab bar and toolbar are now opaque; the sidebar no longer picks up the desktop wallpaper colour.

item.title: Dal 0.1.0
item.description:
• First release: commit graph, line-level staging, drag-and-drop merge/rebase, conflict resolver, undo/redo
  • GitHub pull requests and issues via gh
  • Chrome-style tab groups and Cmd-P quick switcher
  • Switchable Git profiles
